fb-again: Not yet. Try this pattern again.
fb-result_one: {{hits}} of {{total}} note on time. {{early}} early, {{late}} late, {{missed}} missed.
fb-result_other: {{hits}} of {{total}} notes on time. {{early}} early, {{late}} late, {{missed}} missed.
hint-listen: Listen to the rhythm, then tap it back.
hint-ready: A bar of clicks counts you in. Then tap each note.
hint-tap-keys: Tap the pad or press a piano key (A to K) on each note. Stay silent for rests.
hint-tap-mic: The microphone isn't used for rhythm. Tap the pad on each note.
hint-tap-midi: Press a key on your controller on each note. Stay silent for rests.
hint-tap-screen: Tap the pad on each note. Stay silent for rests.
line-count-in: Count in. Get ready to tap.
notice-lost: Sound stopped, so this run was dropped. Try again.
notice-no-audio: Sound isn't playing. Press Listen to try again.
